{{Quote|If you're in the mood for fish, this seafood slider features a grilled firaxan shark fillet in place of the standard patty, topped with Ahto City cheese, chewy Selkathian seaweed and relish squiggles.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Manaan slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Manaan sliders''' were one of the speciality [[slider]]s created and served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] was inspired by<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] planet [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] which was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the ocean dwelling [[Firaxan shark/Legends|firaxan shark]].<ref name="Kotor">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> The slider consisted of a [[firaxan shark fillet]]&mdash;in place of the standard [[Mongo Beefhead patty]]&mdash;topped with [[Ahto City cheese]], chewy [[Selkathian seaweed]] and [[relish]] squiggles all served on a [[medium-density food-board]]. It cost 6.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was served with the diner's special garnish. [[Sernpidalian mayo-ketchup]] and [[Bimm mustard]] were available for the slider upon request.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Manaan sliders were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
